g.text: The card for every kind of selection

The frame and the title pill take the selection’s colors; the dark middle, the info panel and the menu’s buttons stay Koda’s purple. Yellow is still you (“Mine”, your ship), pink still needs attention (a siege).
Selection ring, card lines, scope toggle:
their class or kind color; you yellow; others sky blue
Star and its glow; star button:
by function: sieges pink, leaderboard gold, chat teal, help sky, settings lavender
